name: navbar-fullscreen-menu
title: Fullscreen menu navbar
description: A bar with only the brand and a Menu button that opens a full-screen overlay of large numbered links and contact details.
docs: Pass brand, links ({ label, href, hint }), contact ({ address, email, phone, social }), currentHref and menuLabel. At rest the bar is only the brand and a Menu button, at every screen size. The button opens a full-screen overlay built on Dialog: focus moves in and stays there, Escape or the Close button leaves, and focus returns to the Menu button. The links are set in very large type under a two-digit index, the current one marked with aria-current and a dot, and while one is under the pointer or the keyboard the titles of the others soften to half strength (still 3:1 against the page); choosing a link closes the overlay. From sm up a hint sits at the right of its title in a column of its own, where it wraps (two lines at most) so that no row is taller than the others; below sm it sits under the title. The second column holds the address, the email and phone as links, and the profiles, which open in a new tab. The links arrive one after another with a short stagger, and simply appear under reduced motion. linkAs renders the links with your router's Link; labels translates the fixed words. No state of its own, so it renders on the server.
